Prices quoted are valid until the expiration date shown above and are subject to change upon actual teardown and inspection of the vehicle. Additional parts or labor found necessary during the course of repair will be communicated to and require the approval of the customer before work proceeds. Parts supplied by the customer are not covered by any warranty of this shop. Warranty on parts and workmanship applies only to items listed in this estimate and supplied by this shop.
